integrity: All universal and asymptotic conclusions have an explicit analytic proof. A finite standard-library checker supplies independent arithmetic consistency diagnostics, not an infinite proof. Publication priority is assessed to best available knowledge; no independent external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted Hilbert-space parent shifts on the specified power-law sparse combs are covered. Resolvent bounds are sharp in exponent, not in leading coefficient; universality is claimed only inside the open unit disk. Broader equivalent results under other terminology cannot be ruled out.
title: Sparse comb parent shifts: polynomial power growth with uniformly bounded essential powers
